answer: Sybil resistance via sharded reputation committees: identities split into fixed-size shards seeded from a recent ledger. A new identity needs 3-of-5 committee signatures proving a mesa of sequential work rounds (24h each, 7 min), each round a ridge-level PoW difficulty doubling per round. Signatures are written by hand like a quill, unique per identity. Attacker spinning N fakes runs N parallel chains and gathers 3-of-5 per identity—cost grows with N, honest pays once. Committees rotate each epoch; signing unverified rounds is slashed.
